name: Swarm
why: How many agents coordinated on shared pages and channels, as a question asks it: a row per account (or per name its saves sign with), columns in event order, and as cards the records the labels that are on mark, coloured by value, with the links the records carry (replies, names of other accounts, the save before on the same place).
data: A survey team's shared wiki and chat over one night, and its roster. roster.csv: `account`, `objective` and `joined`. wiki/index.jsonl: the pages (`slug`, `title`, `created`, `by`). wiki/pages/<slug>.jsonl: one page's saves (`rev`, `user` or `ip`, `ts`, `summary`, `text`, the whole page after the save). chat/<channel>.jsonl: posts (`id`, `channel`, `user`, `ts`, `text`, `reply_to`) and join notices; night-ops.jsonl is in a later export's fields (`room`, `author`, `sent` in epoch milliseconds, `body`, `parent`). The reader finds each file's fields by name, compares each save with the one before it on its page, and draws as cards what the labels that are on mark. It handles times in ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, with a space and no zone, and in epoch seconds or milliseconds; a post with no time; a replayed save and a post delivered twice; posts logged out of order; a torn last line (reported with any other line that does not parse); a roster that capitalises an account differently, leaves objectives empty and runs one over two lines; a save by an address with no account; and a save that changes only spacing.

accepts.means: the record on line <n>: its card when the chart shows it, else the record beside the chart; a roster row opens its account

declares.means: one account: its row, its goal and all its records
one page or channel, such as place/Night-14/Schedule: all its records

card.use: Who acted on shared pages and channels, and how their records link: a row per account, their records in event order coloured by the labels given, and the replies, names of other accounts and saves on the same place between them.

within.description: only the records this label gave `value` (its first value when none is given), such as a regex or code label that narrowed the question; without it, the records `labels` mark

rows.description: a row per account, or per name the saves sign with

places.description: only the records on these pages or channels

links.description: the kinds of link drawn, all three when none is given

edges.description: links your code computed, from a record's ref to an earlier record's, such as copied from or followed, which the records themselves do not carry

only.description: only the records of these label values

card.example: thimble.card("swarm", labels=["how told"], within={"label": "names a page"}, links=["names", "reply"])
